name: construct-gygax
description: Gygax construct — game systems analyst skill-pack; code-grounded analysis libs under scripts/lib/codegrounding/

scripts.test:codegrounding: for f in scripts/lib/codegrounding/*.test.ts; do tsx "$f" || exit 1; done

scripts.test:payoff: for f in scripts/lib/payoff/*.test.ts; do tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
